name: EU Digital Services & Digital Markets Act (DSA / DMA / Data Act)
description: Compliance framework for the EU Digital Services Act (DSA - Regulation (EU) 2022/2065), Digital Markets Act (DMA - Regulation (EU) 2022/1925), and EU Data Act, covering notice-and-action illegal content workflows, recommender system transparency, gatekeeper interoperability, and B2B/B2C data sharing.

checklists.name: EU Digital Services & Markets Act Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for DSA, DMA, and EU Data Act compliance obligations.

items.statement: Notice-and-action mechanism allows users to report illegal content and receive electronic receipt confirmation (DSA Art. 16).
Statement of Reasons is issued automatically whenever content is removed, demoted, or accounts suspended (DSA Art. 17).
Recommender systems explain main ranking criteria and offer a non-profiling feed option in terms and conditions (DSA Art. 27).
User interface design avoids dark patterns that deceive, manipulate, or impair user autonomy (DSA Art. 25).
EU Data Act data portability interfaces enable users to transfer generated IoT/cloud data to competing services seamlessly.

reviewGates.name: EU Digital Services Act Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Head of Trust & Safety confirms that content moderation notice-and-action, dark pattern checks, and recommender transparency comply with the DSA.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the platform compliance review confirm full alignment with EU DSA and DMA requirements?
